title: PA5 LED does not blink on Nucleo-F401
user_question: Builds and flashes fine, debugger shows the loop running, but the LED on PA5 stays off.

reference_context.title: STM32F4 Reference Manual RM0090 (ST)
reference_context.section: RCC AHB1 peripheral clock enable register (RCC_AHB1ENR)
reference_context.snippet: GPIOAEN: IO port A clock enable. 0: IO port A clock disabled, 1: IO port A clock enabled. A peripheral's registers cannot be written while its clock is disabled.

expected.root_cause: The GPIOA peripheral clock is never enabled in RCC, so HAL_GPIO_Init's register writes are ignored.
